e.title: **一个 .NET 保费计算引擎：**登记页指向的仓库已经不存在**，**而**组织还在、**公开仓库数为 **0****：NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**；**⭐ 而 **nuspec 里钉着**分支 `refs/heads/insurance-test` 与**提交 `95276c94ee33d005114b5cc50e3f0fa4032360e4`****；**⚠️ 整个引擎是一个 **13,824 字节的 DLL**、**随包的 XML 文档**零条成员**、**README **354 字节****；**⚠️ 只有一个版本、**下载 **155 次****
e.title_en: A .NET premium calculation engine whose registry page points at a repository that no longer exists while the organisation behind it still does with zero public repositories: one version, 155 downloads, a single thirteen-kilobyte assembly, an XML documentation file with no members, and a nuspec that pins a branch and a commit hash that can no longer be fetched.
e.title_hk: **一個 .NET 保費計算引擎：**登記頁指向的倉庫已經不存在**，**而**組織還在、**公開倉庫數為 0****：NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**；**⭐ 而 nuspec 裡釘著**分支 `refs/heads/insurance-test` 與**提交 `95276c94ee33d005114b5cc50e3f0fa4032360e4`****；**⚠️ 整個引擎是一個 **13,824 位元組的 DLL**、**隨包的 XML 文檔**零條成員**、**README **354 位元組****；**⚠️ 只有一個版本、**下載 **155 次****
e.summary: **PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium**（NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`）**是一个 .NET 的**保费计算引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**。**本次实测**：**版本 **2.0.0**（**仅此一版**）、**发布于 **2026-01-13****、**许可 MIT**（**元数据里的许可表达式**）、**标签逐字为** `insurance premium rating calculator actuarial primus`**、**下载 **155 次****；**⚠️ 而**它的 **nuspec 里**写着源码仓库**及其**分支与提交号**，**而**那个仓库**返回 **404****、**背后的组织** `primussoft` **还在**（**2016-10-17 建立**）**、**公开仓库数逐字为 **0****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **登记页与**二进制里**都指向**同一个已消失的仓库****（**⭐ 连 DLL 内嵌的 `RepositoryUrl` 也是它**）**；**② **整个引擎**只有一个 **13,824 字节的 DLL**，**而**随包的 XML 文档**零条成员**（**逐字为空的 `<members></members>`**）**；**③ **README **354 字节**，**只给一段 `AddPrimusPremiumCalculator()` 与一个把**邮编写成 `90210` 的**例子**；**④ **⚠️ **许可只在元数据里**，**包内**没有任何许可文件****。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未调用**；**⭐ 而**本次**把包体解开了**（**14 个文件、**116 KB**）**。
e.summary_hk: **PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium**（NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`）**是一個 .NET 的**保費計算引擎****——**逐字自述為**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**。**本次實測**：**版本 2.0.0（**僅此一版**）**、**發布於 2026-01-13**、**許可 MIT**（**元資料裡的許可表達式**）**、**標籤逐字為** `insurance premium rating calculator actuarial primus`**、**下載 155 次****；**⚠️ 而 nuspec 裡**寫著源碼倉庫**及其**分支與提交號**，**而**那個倉庫**返回 404****、**組織** `primussoft` **還在**（**2016-10-17 建立**）**、**公開倉庫數逐字為 0****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **登記頁與二進位裡**都指向**同一個已消失的倉庫**（**連 DLL 內嵌的 `RepositoryUrl` 也是它**）**；**② **整個引擎**只有一個 13,824 位元組的 DLL**，**而**隨包的 XML 文檔**零條成員**；**③ **README 354 位元組**，**只給一段 `AddPrimusPremiumCalculator()` 與一個把**郵編寫成 `90210` 的**例子**；**④ **⚠️ **許可只在元資料裡**，**包內**沒有任何許可文件****。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未調用**；**⭐ 而本次**把包體解開了**（**14 個檔案、**116 KB**）**。
e.summary_en: This NuGet package **is a premium calculation engine for .NET**, described verbatim as flexible and supporting defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating and discounting logic. **Measured this round**: a single version 2.0.0 published in January, an MIT licence recorded as a metadata expression, tags naming insurance, premium, rating, calculator, actuarial and primus, and one hundred and fifty-five downloads. **Its nuspec names a source repository together with a branch and a commit hash, and that repository returns 404, while the organisation behind it still exists, created in 2016, with zero public repositories.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.** **Four things are worth reading: both the registry page and the compiled assembly point at the same vanished repository, since the dead URL is embedded inside the binary as well; the entire engine is one thirteen-kilobyte assembly whose shipped XML documentation file contains an empty members element; the readme is three hundred and fifty-four bytes and gives one service-registration call and an example that rates on a United States postal code; and the licence exists only as metadata, with no licence file anywhere in the package.** **The package was not installed and not called, but the package body was unpacked and counted: fourteen files in about a hundred and sixteen kilobytes.**
e.body:
**PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium**（NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`）**是一个 .NET 的**保费计算引擎****——**逐字自述为**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**另一个登记处：企业侧的包登记**」**。

**可核实信息（均 NuGet 元数据、登记资源与包体实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 登记页与二进制指向同一个已消失的仓库**——**nuspec 逐字含** `<repository type="git" url="https://github.com/primussoft/Primus-SaaS-Framework" branch="refs/heads/insurance-test" commit="95276c94ee33d005114b5cc50e3f0fa4032360e4" />`**；**⭐ 本次实测**该仓库 URL **返回 **404****，**而**其所属组织 **`primussoft` 返回 **200****（**逐字为** `Organization`、**创建于 **2016-10-17**、**`public_repos` **0****）**——**⭐ 即**「**仓库没了，**组织还在，**而**组织里**一个公开仓库也没有**」**；**⭐⭐ 本文**最值得记录的一处**：**把包解开后**，**其 **DLL 内嵌的 **`RepositoryUrl` 字符串**仍是**同一个 **404 地址****——**⭐ 即**这条**死链**不只写在登记页上**，**还**被编进**已发布两年以上的二进制**里**。**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**nuspec 钉的是**分支名与提交号**（**`insurance-test` 分支**）**——**⭐ 而**这意味着**即使仓库还在**，**该提交**是否仍可达**也**需要单独核实**；**本次**无从核实**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 整个引擎的体量**——**包体 **14 个文件／**116 KB****，**其中 **`lib/` 下四份 DLL**（**net6.0／**net7.0／**net8.0／**net9.0**）**，**net8.0 那一份逐字为 **`Primus.Insurance.Premium.dll`，**13,824 字节****；**⭐ 并**随包一份同名 **`.xml` 文档**，**逐字内容为空的成员表**（**`<members></members>`**）**——**⭐ 即**它**声明了要带文档**，**而**文档里**一条成员都没有**。**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**⭐ 这不是**「**没有文档**」**，**而是**「**随包附了文档文件，**而**文件是空的**」**——**⭐ 与本会话早先记下的**「**登记处描述指向不存在的文件**」**同族**。**⭐⭐ ③ README **354 字节**，**内容只有两段**——**⚠️ 逐字为一句**「**High-performance rating engine for insurance premiums.**」**，**加一段 **C# 片段**：**注册** `builder.Services.AddPrimusPremiumCalculator();`**，**再**调用** `await _calculator.CalculateAsync(new RatingRequest { ProductCode = "AUTO", RiskFactors = new() { { "Age", 24 }, { "ZipCode", "90210" } } })`**——**⭐ 本词条认为**两个细节值得记**：**① **风险因子是**一张**字符串到对象的字典****（**`RiskFactors`**）**，**⭐ 即**「**因子名**」**由**调用方**自己约定**，**引擎**不定义因子表**；**② **例子里的产品码是 **`AUTO`**、**邮编是 **`90210`**（**美国格式**）**——**⭐ 而**描述里**同时声称**支持**确定给付与**确定缴费**（**即养老金类**）**，**⭐ 本词条**据此只记录其自述**，**不主张**该引擎**真能覆盖**这几类业务**。**⭐⭐ ④ 从二进制字符串可见的公开名称只有几个**——**逐字含** `RatingRequest`、**`CalculateAsync`、**`AppliedDiscounts`（**含其属性后备字段**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**：**本次**没有**做**程序集元数据反射**，**故**「**字符串清单**」**不等于**「**API 清单**」**，**也不等于**「**引擎能力清单**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 许可只在元数据里**——**许可表达式逐字为 **MIT**（**`licenses.nuget.org/MIT`**）**，**而**包内 **14 个文件里**没有**任何许可文件****（**⭐ 本次**逐文件核对**）**——**⭐ 这一形态**本会话**此前已记为**「**许可只在元数据里、**包内无文件**」**，**本词条**如实指出**这是**同一形态在另一个登记处**的再现**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 依赖与目标框架被写全**——**四组目标框架**（**net6.0／**7.0／**8.0／**9.0**）**各自**依赖三个 **`Microsoft.Extensions.*` **8.0.0 包**（**依赖注入抽象、**日志抽象与**选项**）**——**⭐ 即**它**按 **.NET 的现代约定**发布**（**多目标 ＋ 依赖注入**）**，**⭐ 而**这也**解释了** README 里**为什么只有**一句注册代码**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[policyforge-rating-engine]]、**[[openrater]]、**[[ratecraft]]、**[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、**[[motor-pricing-glm]] 覆盖**费率与**定价引擎**（**多为 Python 或**R 生态**）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**.NET 生态里的**保费计算引擎**，**其源码仓库已不可达**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的是一个**五步核对动作**：**① 看登记页给的仓库**；**② 打不开就去看**组织本身**（**⭐ 组织存在而仓库数为 0** 是**一种常被忽略的情形**）**；**③ 把包解开**看**里面到底有什么**；**④ 随包文档**是否真的有内容**；**⑤ **许可**是**写在元数据里**、**还是**包里真有文件**。**⭐ 五步走完**，「**登记处里有这个包**」**才**变成**一句**有内容的话**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用其任何 API**（**未计算任何保费、**未运行任何费率**）**，**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**不主张**其任何计算结果**。**② ⚠️ **源码不可得**——**登记页指定的仓库返回 **404****，**故**本次**无法看到**任何源码**；**⭐ 本条目对引擎内容的描述**全部来自**包内二进制**与**其字符串**，**而**这些**不足以**说明**其算法与正确性**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `RepositoryUrl` **是否**曾经存在过**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**仓库为何不可达**）**。**④ ⚠️ **`primussaas` 这一归一化形式**是**登记资源实际使用的 ID**（**⭐ 本次**最初**按**包名大小写**手工推导**写成三个 `s`**，**导致**两个资源**误报 **404****——**⭐ 那一处**不是**登记处异常**，**而是**本词条自己的推导错误**，**已更正**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其目标框架与**许可表达式**是否与**实际发布内容**完全一致**（**⭐ 只核对了**包内无许可文件**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**发布者身份**（**NuGet 上逐字为** `Primus SaaS`，**所有者名** `AkkiKhan`**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该包发布于 **2026-01-13**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**且**仅此一版**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**.NET 生态里的**保费计算引擎**，**而**其登记页与**二进制内嵌地址**共同指向**一个**已不可达的仓库**」这一形态**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其费率逻辑**须**由使用机构自行验证**。

e.body_hk:
**PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium**（NuGet 包 `PrimusSaaS.Insurance.Premium`）**是一個 .NET 的**保費計算引擎****——**逐字自述為**「**Flexible premium calculation engine for .NET. Supports defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating, and discounting logic.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**另一個登記處：企業側的包登記**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 NuGet 元資料、登記資源與包體實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 登記頁與二進位指向同一個已消失的倉庫**——**nuspec 逐字含** `<repository type="git" url="https://github.com/primussoft/Primus-SaaS-Framework" branch="refs/heads/insurance-test" commit="95276c94ee33d005114b5cc50e3f0fa4032360e4" />`**；**⭐ 本次實測**該倉庫 URL **返回 404****，**而**其組織 **`primussoft` 返回 200****（**`Organization`、**創建於 2016-10-17**、**`public_repos` 0****）**——**⭐ 即**「**倉庫沒了，**組織還在，**而**組織裡**一個公開倉庫也沒有**」**；**⭐⭐ 最值得記錄的一處**：**把包解開後**，**其 DLL 內嵌的 `RepositoryUrl` 字符串**仍是**同一個 404 地址****——**⭐ 即**這條**死鏈**不只寫在登記頁上**，**還**被編進**已發布的二进制**裡**。**⭐ nuspec 釘的是**分支名與提交號**（**`insurance-test` 分支**）**——**⭐ 而**這意味著**即使倉庫還在**，**該提交是否仍可達**也**需要單獨核實**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 引擎的體量**——**包體 14 個檔案／**116 KB****，**`lib/` 下四份 DLL**（**net6.0／**7.0／**8.0／**9.0**）**，**net8.0 那份逐字為 **`Primus.Insurance.Premium.dll`，**13,824 位元組****；**⭐ 並**隨包一份同名 `.xml` 文檔**，**逐字內容為**空的成員表**（**`<members></members>`**）**——**⭐ 即**它**聲明了要帶文檔**，**而**文檔裡**一條成員都沒有**。**⭐⭐ ③ README 354 位元組**，**只有兩段**：**逐字一句**「**High-performance rating engine for insurance premiums.**」**，**加一段 C# 片段**（**註冊** `AddPrimusPremiumCalculator()`，**再**以 `RatingRequest` 調用 `CalculateAsync`，**風險因子為 `Age` 24 與** `ZipCode` 90210**）**——**⭐ 兩個細節值得記**：**① **風險因子是**一張**字符串到對象的字典****，**⭐ 即**因子名**由**調用方**自己約定**；**② **例子裡產品碼為 `AUTO`、**郵編為美國格式****——**⭐ 而**描述同時聲稱**支持確定給付與**確定繳費**，**本詞條**只記錄其自述**。**⭐⭐ ④ 二進位字符串裡可見的公開名稱只有幾個**（**`RatingRequest`、**`CalculateAsync`、**`AppliedDiscounts` 及其後備欄位**）**——**⭐ 本次**沒有**做**程式集元資料反射**，**故**字符串清單**不等於** API 清單**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 許可只在元資料裡**（**表達式逐字為 MIT**）**，**而**包內 14 個檔案裡**沒有**任何許可文件**（**逐檔案核對**）**——**⭐ 同一形態**在**另一個登記處**再現**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 依賴與目標框架被寫全**：**四組框架各自依賴三個 `Microsoft.Extensions.*` 8.0.0 包**——**⭐ 即**它按 .NET 的**現代約定**發布**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[policyforge-rating-engine]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]]、[[motor-pricing-glm]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**.NET 生態的保費計算引擎，**其源碼倉庫已不可達**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 最值得借的是一個五步核對動作**：**① 看登記頁給的倉庫**；**② 打不開就去看組織本身**（**組織存在而倉庫數為 0** 是**常被忽略的情形**）**；**③ 解開包**看**裡面到底有什麼**；**④ 隨包文檔**是否真有內容**；**⑤ **許可是**寫在元資料裡**，**還是**包裡真有文件**。**⭐ 五步走完**，「**登記處裡有這個包**」**才變成**一句**有內容的話**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該包、**沒有調用其任何 API**，**不主張**其任何功能可用或任何計算結果**。**② ⚠️ **源碼不可得**——**登記頁指定的倉庫返回 404****，**故**本次**看不到**任何源碼**；**對引擎內容的描述**全部來自**包內二進位與其字符串**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `RepositoryUrl` **是否曾經存在**（**不推測其為何不可達**）**。**④ ⚠️ **`primussaas` 這一歸一化形式**是**登記資源實際使用的 ID****——**本次最初**按包名大小寫**手工推導**寫成三個 `s`，**導致兩個資源誤報 404**——**⭐ 那不是登記處異常**，**而是本詞條自己的推導錯誤**，**已更正**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**目標框架與許可表達式**是否與**實際發布內容**完全一致**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者身份**（**NuGet 上逐字為 `Primus SaaS`，**所有者名 `AkkiKhan`**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**發布於 2026-01-13（**窗口之外**）**，**僅此一版**——**本條的缺口是**「**.NET 生態的保費計算引擎，**而**登記頁與二進位內嵌地址**共同指向**一個**已不可達的倉庫**」這一形態**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該包不是**任何持牌精算意見**。

This NuGet package **is a premium calculation engine for .NET**, described verbatim as flexible and supporting defined benefit, defined contribution, multi-factor rating and discounting logic. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a second kind of registry, the one enterprises publish into.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the registration resources and the unpacked package**: **first, the registry page and the compiled binary point at the same vanished repository.** The nuspec names a git repository with an explicit branch and commit hash, the repository returns 404, and the organisation that owns it returns a normal response describing itself as an organisation created in 2016 **with zero public repositories** — a shape worth recording, because the repository is gone while the organisation is not, and the organisation holds nothing public at all. **After unpacking the package, the dead URL is still embedded inside the compiled assembly as its repository URL, so the broken link is not only printed on the registry page but compiled into a binary that has been published since January.** This entry also states plainly that the nuspec pins a branch name and a commit hash, so even if the repository returned, whether that commit is still reachable would need separate verification, which was not possible here. **Second, on the size of the whole engine**: fourteen files in about a hundred and sixteen kilobytes, of which four assemblies target four framework versions from .NET 6 through .NET 9, the current one being a single assembly of thirteen thousand eight hundred and twenty-four bytes, shipped with a documentation file of the same name whose members element is empty. **That is worth stating precisely: it is not that no documentation was written, but that a documentation file was packaged and contains nothing.** **Third, the readme is three hundred and fifty-four bytes and contains two things**: one sentence calling the package a high-performance rating engine for insurance premiums, and a short code block that registers the calculator through dependency injection and then calls it with a rating request whose risk factors are a dictionary from strings to arbitrary values, using an auto product code and a United States postal code. **Two details matter there: the risk factors are a caller-defined dictionary, so the engine itself defines no factor table; and the example is both auto and United States shaped while the description also claims defined benefit and defined contribution support, so this entry records the claim without asserting that the engine really covers those lines.** **Fourth, the only public names visible from the binary are a request type, an asynchronous calculation method and a discount collection with its backing field**, and **this entry marks plainly that no assembly metadata reflection was performed, so a list of strings is neither an API list nor a capability list**. **Fifth, the licence exists only as metadata**: an MIT expression, with no licence file anywhere among the fourteen packaged files, which was checked file by file — **the same shape this session has already recorded, now recurring in a different registry**. **Sixth, dependencies and target frameworks are complete**: four framework groups each depending on three Microsoft.Extensions packages at version 8.0.0, which is the modern .NET convention and explains why the readme needs only one registration line. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover rating and pricing engines, mostly in the Python and R ecosystems, **while this entry supplies a premium calculation engine in the .NET ecosystem whose source repository is no longer reachable. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **the transferable habit is a five-step check — read the repository named on the registry page; when it does not open, look at the organisation itself, since an organisation that exists with zero repositories is an easily missed case; unpack the package and see what is actually inside; check whether the shipped documentation file has content; and check whether the licence is only metadata or a real file. Only after those five steps does the sentence this package exists in the registry acquire content.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and none of its APIs was called**, so no premium was computed and no rate was run, **and no claim is made that any feature works or that any result is correct**. **Second, the source is unavailable** because the repository named on the registry page returns 404, **so everything said here about the engine comes from the packaged binary and its strings, which is not enough to establish its algorithms or their correctness**. **Third, whether that repository ever existed was not verified, and this entry does not speculate about why it is unreachable.** **Fourth, the normalised identifier actually used by the registration resources is the one with the doubled letter at the junction between the two words in the package name.** **This entry first derived that identifier by hand, wrote an extra letter, and thereby misread two registry resources as missing; that was not a registry anomaly but this entry own mistake, and it is corrected here.** **Fifth, whether the target frameworks and the licence expression match the published contents exactly was not verified**, only that no licence file is inside the package. **Sixth, the publisher identity was not verified**, the registry naming a company and an individual owner. **Seventh, on the window: the package was published in January, outside the thaw window, and it has exactly one version**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap is a premium calculation engine in the .NET ecosystem whose registry page and embedded binary address both point at a repository that can no longer be reached. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the package is not a licensed actuarial opinion and that its rating logic must be validated by the institution using it.**
